full_judgment: 2. Facts in short are that the opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff filed above vested case No. 1161 of 2014 in the court of Arpito Shampatti Prottarpan Tribunal for release of scheduled property alleging that the disputed property belonged to Suraj Bashini who had no child. So she adopted Niva Rani Dhar and Ganga Narayan Chakraverty and made a will in favour of them on 31-1-1965. Above Niva Rani and Ganga Narayan got probate on 21-5-1966 in probate case No 15 of 1965. The Government filed revocation case No. 157 of 1969 which was dismissed on 14-11-1972. Niva Rani filed an Eviction case being No. 409 of 1967 for disputed property which was decreed and an appeal filed against above judgment and decree was dismissed. A second appeal to the High Court Division was also dismissed. Opposite Party No. 1 purchased the scheduled property from above Niva Rani Dhar by a registered kobla deed on 29-10-1979.
